notes: No open-access or repository copy located; IEEE Xplore is paywalled, so source.md is a metadata and abstract snapshot from OpenAlex. The abstract gives fused accuracies on all five datasets but no unimodal arm, so EEG-only figures are recorded on the card as reported-but-not-accessible. The modality-ablation experiment this entry is carded for -- replacing the EEG features with noise -- is named in the abstract but its numbers are not, which is the single most valuable missing fact in this entry and is worth re-attempting with institutional access. Percent signs in the OpenAlex abstract are HTML-escaped (%) and are reproduced as escaped in source.md.
